title: Palestinian Rappers Shabjdeed and Saint Levant in Spat Over Authenticity
summary_full: Shabjdeed, a rapper in the West Bank, criticized a fellow Palestinian musician in a song, saying his Western lifestyle and lyrics were far removed from life back home.
